programme.title: Computer Science Major (BS/BA Degrees) | Academics | Computer Science | Northwestern Engineering
programme.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (McCormick School of Engineering); also a Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science through Weinberg College; 4 years, fall (September) quarter start
programme.how_found: northwestern.edu -> McCormick School of Engineering -> Computer Science -> Academics -> Undergraduate Programs (lists 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science') -> cs-major/index.html.
programme.notes: English-only site. Admission is to the university/school, not by major; english, deadline, tuition and aid come from the university-wide admissions (admissions.northwestern.edu) and financial aid (undergradaid.northwestern.edu) pages (owner ruling for US universities).

value.accepted_tests: Duolingo English Test, IELTS (incl. IELTS Indicator), TOEFL iBT

english.quote: While there is no minimum score required by Northwestern, competitive applicants demonstrate a high level of English proficiency and typically score in the high range on all sections of the exams we accept
english.notes: University-wide. A proficiency score is required when the first/primary language is not English or secondary schooling was not in English; no minimum score; no superscoring of English tests.

gpa.notes: No GPA minimum published; holistic review. SAT/ACT optional ('Applicants may submit a score if they wish, but scores are not required').

deadline.quote: Application deadlines QuestBridge Applicant Early Decision First-Year Applicant Regular Decision First-Year Applicant Early Decision Transfer Applicant Regular Decision Transfer Applicant Application Due Date October 1, 2026 November 1, 2026 January 4, 2027
deadline.notes: International applicants follow the same procedures and deadlines as domestic ones (international FAQ). Regular Decision first-year due January 4, 2027 (third column); Early Decision November 1, 2026. Financial aid due February 1, 2027 (RD). Fall 2027 start. No timezone printed.

value.academic_year: not stated on the page (current cost of attendance; 'a standard academic year: fall, winter and spring terms')

tuition.notes: On-campus cost of attendance total $99,375 (tuition 71,802; fees 1,260; housing and meals 22,941; books 1,239; personal 2,079; loan fees 54). The page prints no academic year.

scholarship_exists.quote: The NU Scholarship is generally the final component of an aid package, meeting any remaining need after other forms of aid have been applied
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based institutional scholarship; 'approximately half of undergraduates received a Northwestern University Scholarship' (2025-26). Aid limited to four years for entering first-years.

scholarship_international.quote: International candidates seeking financial aid are evaluated in a need-aware manner
scholarship_international.notes: International first-year applicants can request need-based aid with the admission application (CSS Profile or ISAFA, RD aid deadline in early February); admission is need-aware for them ('the process will be more competitive'). Competitive; sized by need assessment.
